scenarios.title: Affected firmware versus corrected firmware
scenarios.status: PASS at library level (tests/test_scenario_nb001_nb002.py, product match_item); PASS at product-CLI level (tests/test_scenario_nb001_nb002_cli.py, local subprocess, real SQLite, run only where a product checkout is present); BLOCKED at API and MCP-server level (no fastapi stack in this harness's environment); UNCHECKED at hosted-staging level
expected_behavior: A vendor-published affected version is not treated as corrected.
A vendor-published fixed version is not treated as affected by that advisory unless the vendor states otherwise.
Vendor advisory applicability is not evidence that a particular customer owns or operates the asset.

scenarios.title: Discontinued hardware with no available fix
scenarios.status: PASS at library level (tests/test_scenario_nb001_nb002.py, product match_item); PASS at product-CLI level (tests/test_scenario_nb001_nb002_cli.py); BLOCKED at API and MCP-server level; UNCHECKED at hosted-staging level
expected_behavior: The discontinued device is identified as having no vendor fix available in the cited advisory.
The system does not invent a corrected version or imply that an upgrade exists.
Recommended mitigations are not represented as a vendor patch.

scenarios.title: Source refresh, deduplication and history
expected_behavior: Every fetch records source, retrieval time, HTTP status, byte length and SHA-256.
Refreshing a source does not silently rewrite historical observations.
An absent EPSS result is represented as unknown or unavailable, not zero.
A record absent from CISA KEV is not reported as known exploited by KEV.

scenarios.title: Tampered, duplicated and out-of-order evidence records
scenarios.status: PASS at library level for tamper, removed middle event, cut tail (signed anchor) and duplicate visibility (tests/test_scenario_nb005.py); BLOCKED for out-of-order delivery (no product interface at the ledger layer) and for API idempotency; product-CLI level (tests/test_attack_attest_cli.py, tests/test_attack_coverage_cli.py): rollback, wrong key and tampered-ledger cases PASS on product main, but the missing/empty attestation-log and deleted-intervention coverage cases FAIL on product main (a135c0e) and PASS only with the unmerged fixes neuralbridge#55 and #57
expected_behavior: Duplicate event delivery does not create a second logical event where idempotency is required.
Out-of-order or missing sequence data is not silently accepted as a complete history.
The original event objects remain unchanged by test processing.
